text.en:
MALACAÑAN PALACE
BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
[ EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 341, October 04, 1971 ]
CREATING THE PRESIDENTIAL INVESTIGATION AND RECOVERY COMMISSION
WHEREAS, a certain government agencies are faced with the prospect of having to incur huge losses for lack
of an efficient mechanism by which investigate and enforce collection of their receivables and recovery of
their invested funds and properties;
WHEREAS, the present state of the government finances is such that it can ill afford to dissipate its property
and monetary resources, but on the contrary has to avail of every possible means to recoup and augment the
WHEREAS, there has been a long-felt need for a government agency charged with the primary responsibility
of looking after the collectibles and recoverable funds, monies and properties of government firms and
effecting their collection and recovery; and
WHEREAS, the magnitude of the job is such that it requires a top-level government body with adequate
powers and functions to effectively pursue its tasks;
NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers
vested in me by law, do hereby create a Commission to be known as the Presidential Investigation and
Recovery Commission under the Office of the President composed of the following:
The Secretary of Justice Chairman
The Chairman-General Manager, RCA Vice-Chairman
The Undersecretary of Industry Member
A representative of the Auditor General Member
A representative of the PNB Member
The Presidential Investigation and Recovery Commission (PIRC) shall have the following powers and
a. Administer, direct, oversee, supervise and take charge of the collection and recovery of all government
assets, stocks, funds, monies and other real or personal properties;
b. Execute and enforce the payment of all claims, demands, liabilities and obligations due and owing to the
Government from any person, corporation, firm or entity;
c. Investigate, initiate court action, or in any lawful manner proceed against any person, corporation or firm
for the enforcement of any contract, bond, guarantee, mortgage, pledge or other collateral executed in favor of
the Government;
d. Prescribe and issue rules and guidelines to government entities concerned on the preparation of contracts,
making of investments and undertaking of financial transactions with the end in view of facilitating their
enforcement, collection and recovery; and
e. In general, to do and perform such lawful and incidental functions as may be necessary and proper to attain
its objectives and accomplish its tasks.
The Commission is hereby authorized to call on any department, bureau, office, agency or instrumentality of
the Government for such service, assistance and cooperation as may be necessary in fulfilling its functions and
responsibilities and to enlist the services of any government official or employee in the pursuit of its tasks.
The Commission shall direct its attention as a priority concern to the investigation, collection and recovery of
RCA assets, money claims and properties. It is hereby authorized to organize its secretariat.
The Commission shall render periodic progress reports of its activities to the Executive Secretary.
Done in the City of Manila, this 4th day of October, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-one.
(SGD.) FERDINAND E. MARCOS
President of the Philippines
By the President:
(SGD.) ROBERTO V. REYES
Acting Executive Secretary
